dedupe_keys.name: inventory of shallow landslides triggered by extreme precipitation in july 2023 in beijing china

description: Inventory of shallow landslides triggered by extreme precipitation in July 2023 in Beijing, China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hao Ma et al. The extreme meteorological events caused by climate change have increasingly caused serious clustered landslides. A systematic and timely inventory of triggered landslides is a prerequisite for quantifying and evaluating the impact of extreme meteorological events. In addition, a landslide inventory can provide basic data for any subsequent analysis of the event or be used innovatively in landslide risk analysis. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2024. Formats: Shapefile, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 328179985 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
